content.en: [READ] Praise the Lord from the heavens; praise Him in the heights. Praise Him, all His angels; praise Him, all His hosts... (Psalms 148, 149, 150)

Let everything that hath breath praise the Lord! Praise the Lord from the heavens; praise Him in the heights. To Thee is due a hymn, O God. Praise Him, all His angels; praise Him, all His hosts. To Thee is due a hymn, O God. [Stichera follow...]
Praise the Lord from the heavens...
Sing to the Lord a new song...
Praise God in His holy place...
